_doc: Configuration of the model used by analyze.py. Choose the profile with 'active' or the --profile option. API keys go in config\api_keys.txt, on the line named by api_key_env (never in this file). report_language: language of the findings, answers and summaries written by the model (en, fr, de, nl, es...).

ollama._doc: Local model: no data leaves the machine. The model must support tool calling; otherwise tool_mode = json.

mock._doc: Tests without a model: replays a script of answers.

evidence_policy._doc: Enforced by the program (guards.py), whatever confidence the model declares. A finding of a severity listed in corroboration_severities stays 'confirmed' only with min_independent_sources independent sources (same .evtx file or same artifact type = same source); otherwise it is recorded as 'probable'. Evidence from outputs mapped automatically (mapping = 'auto') cannot confirm on its own unless auto_mapping_can_confirm is true. An analyst can override a finding in findings.json: "analyst_override": {"confidence": "confirmed", "by": "name", "reason": "..."}, then regenerate the report.

limits._doc_budget: max_billed_tokens_per_run: cap per run of analyze.py, in full-price input-equivalent tokens (cache read = 10 %, output = 5x). 0 = no limit. When reached, the state is saved: run again to continue.
